classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim transcript of a parliamentary debate, created at the time of the event by the Council of States.
classification.resume: The document is a parliamentary record of a debate in the Council of States concerning a cantonal initiative on the federal law on health insurance, held during the spring session of 2001. It contains a speech by Françoise Saudan. The record is part of the Swiss Federal Archives' holdings of the Council of States' meeting protocols.
